notes.title: 1.43 Patch Released
notes.content:
Version 1.43 changelog

Fixes:
	Fixed stupid "Dropped Sync Frame" netcode bug
	Fixed some minor map setup problems
	Fixed lag from ricochet effects on complex ships
	Improved performance of tethers
	Fixed some incorrect Designer warnings
	
Gameplay:
	Reduced base collision damage by 12.5%
	Better Collision Damage tolerance for battleships
	Liquid Rocket engine now regenerates fuel, instead of limiting you to 3 burns
	Mastermind Servers can now set specific budget limits
	Started using the Metric system in one place

New Parts
	Pyrotechnic Bolt
	Contact Trigger
	Proximity Trigger
	Spinal Weapon Guidance
	
Designer Changes:
	Added "Undo" System
	Gimbal Memorizes your Mirror and Snap settings
	Software Parts have color coded icons
	Certain parts can now link with Software parts (chaining)
	Added coarse and fine Rotation (CTRL & SHIFT keys)
	
Server Management:
	Created the "GimbalServerBuddy", which watches gimbal servers and restarts them if they go down

notes.title: Update News
notes.content:
Development work for the upcoming [b]Unlimited Mode[/b] is complete.

We want to make this patch great, so we will also be developing a leader boards feature and an assortment of larger structural parts for the battleships that players are likely to build.

Stay tuned, Super Admirals.

notes.title: Gimbal News
notes.content:
Thank you for bringing Gimbal to Steam, Gimbal pilots! The next Gimbal update is well on its way and will include an assortment of improvements, fixes, and:

[h1]Unlimited Mode[/h1]

Gimbal creations have always been capped at $6000 Trillion Dollars, but [b]Unlimited Mode[/b] will obliterate that cap. Let's see the Gimbal creations you can design.

Look for the update in the coming weeks, and work on your Kewl Pointz™ in the meantime.
